A “Setu” coin with a bull on the obverse: Fasoŋu xaalis bu tuddu “Setu” ak nag ci kanamam. Baatu Setu — pont bi jëm Lanka, ci Rameswaram — dafa feeñ ci piyeesu xaalis yu njiiti Tamil yu mujj ci royaume bu Jaffna; nag couchant, Nandi Shiva, mooy seen jumtukaay bu ñuy jëfandikoo.
A burial urn of the kind that made Adich: Urne dëj bu nuru xeetu urne bu siiwal Adichanallur. Ñi dee, wala seeni yax yuñ dajale, dañu leen dugal ci urne yu mel noonu, ñu def leen ci bàmmeel, ñu suul leen ci suuf su am xeer, ci kaw Thamirabarani. Urn yi dañu lëkkaloo bu baax ak முதுமக்கள் தாழி Sangam yi.
A catalogue of the coins issued by the C: Limu xaalis bu buur yi Chera, Chola, ak Pandya defar, ak seeni màndarga yu melni bow, tigre ak jën.
A ceramic vessel from Adichanallur. Smal: Adichanallur Ay pot yu ndaw yu mel ni yii dañu leen daan def ci biir wala ci wetu urne yu ñuy suul, amaana ñuy tëye lekk, ndox wala sarax ngir néew yi — muy wane ngëmu Iron Age ci tukki bu weesu dee.
A chariot for a creeper, a shawl for a p: Wagon ngir luy raam, shawl ngir jàmbu joob, meññeef buy dundal ngir taalifkat: kado yi gëna siiw ci kiliyaan yi dañu melni lu amul njariñ, te loolu mooy seen xalaat. Kodai madam mooy xéewal gu bari ba ki koy joxe xamul njariñu kado bi - yërëm gu yaatu ci baayima yi, garab yi ak jàng yépp.
A Chera coin in the collection of the Na: Benn piyeesu Chera buñ denc ci Musée bu Napier, Thiruvananthapuram. Chera xaalis dañuy màndargaal bow ak fett, emblem dynasty, ak misaal yu bari yu njëkk ñu ngi bawoo Karur, diggu Chera ci Amaravathi.
A chieftain of the Ay line in the southe: Benn njiit ci lignée Ay ci tundu Podiyil (Pothigai) ci sud. Amna cosaan ak aada bu siiw buy nettali ni dafa daan saraxe yéere yu am solo benn yàlla, ñu bari xamee ko ci Shiva — saraxe ko ni devotion ak laabiir.
A chieftain of the Malaiyaman lineage, o: Benn njiit ci xeetu Malaiyaman, ci réew mi wër Mullur ak Tirukkoyilur, ñu koy fàttaliku ci mbaaxam ci taalifkat yi ak ci képp ku ñëwoon ci moom. Barab bimu am ci juróom ñaari njiit yi dafay wane ni, li ñuy nattee njukkal bu njiit mooy limu daan joxe ak ci réewam.
A Chola coin carrying Pandya royal insig: Fasoŋu Chola bu yor màndarga buur bu Pandya. Bi waa Chola jëlee réewum Pandya ci seen nguur, ñu daal di teg jënu Pandya ci wetu seen tigre — muy màndargaal ndam li ñu def ci wen.
A city where literature, royal patronage: Dëkk bu literature, patronage royal, diine ak dundu ville daje lu tollu ci ñaari junniy at.
A coin of Kulottunga Chola bearing the t: Benn piyeesu xaalis bu Kulottunga Chola bu am titre "Malai Nadu konda Chola" - Chola bi jël réewu tundu wi, maanaam réewu Chera. Buur yi ci Chola dañu daan fësal seen ndam ci ay titre yu ñu bind ci seen piyees xaalis ak ci seen mbind.
A coin of Kulottunga I (1070–1120 CE), w: Benn piyeesu xaalis bu Kulottunga I (1070–1120 ginaaw JC), moo boole Chola ak Chalukya Penku ba noppi jiite benn ci nguuri Chola yi gëna gudd te gëna am xaalis. Fayam yi dañuy wéyal xeetu Chola yiñ tabax ak turam ci Nagari.
A coin of Rajaraja I. His copper coins o: Fasoŋu xaalisu Rajaraja I. Fasoŋu përëm yu melni buur bu taxaw ak bu toog, ñu dugal ko ginaaw bimu amee nord bu Sri Lanka, ñu daan wër bu baax ci ñaari wetu géej gi, ñu toppandoo ko lu weesu xarnu yu bari.
A coin of the Jaffna kingdom showing a h: Benn piyeesu xaalis bu réewum Jaffna bu wane fas ak jën. Buuru Tamil yu Jaffna (13eem ba 17eem xarnu) dañu daan génne xaalis ci cosaan ak aada waa Inde du Sud, loolu dafay fàttali nit ñi seen diggante bu baax ak Palk Strait.
A coin of the Kongu Cheras, the Chera li: Benn piyeesu Kongu Cheras, lignée Chera bi jiitewoon réewum Kongu ci diwaanu Tamil bu sowwu (ci wetu Coimbatore, Erode ak Karur leegi) — diwaan bi jur ay piyeesu xaalis yu bari ci Rome.
A crowned, moustached figure in profile,: Benn nit bu am kuronu, am mustache ci profil, sol vest bu am ay takkaay ak ay foulard yuy naaw, di siggil benn yatt bu am catu dunqu. Kanam gi ak loxo yi dañu leen rëdd ci liiñ bu ñuul bu rafet ci kaw suuf su lewet, robb yi ñu raxas ci oker, rose ak wert - muy nuru nataal buy jàngat yéere buur ci tablo barabu jaamukaay.
A detail of the painted ceiling of the J: Ay detay ci plafoŋ biñ pente ci barabu jaamukaay bu Jain ci Sittanavasal: ay lotus yu rose yu ubbeeku ci biir ay pad yu wert, baayima buy daw ci ndox mi ak nit kuy dajale ay flër. Piscine bi dañu koy faral di wax ni fosse lotus bu samavasarana, di barabu asamaan bi Jain Tirthankara di waare, ak gëm-gëm yi dajale ay flër ngir saraxe.
A funerary vessel from the burial cairns: Gaal giñ defar ngir dëj, ñu jële ko ci tundu Nilgiri, mu am jëmm yuñ defaree jëmm. Ci fukk ak ñeenteelu xarnu bi, ñiy gas ci Nilgiri cairns, gis nañu ay muur yu bari yu am nit, baayima ak warkat - seen yu ndaw ci ban yu mëna wane dundu ak tolluwaayu néew yi.
A garland of about a hundred and fifty a: Garland bu tollu ci téemeeri ak juróom fukki aaya akam yu Kanimethaviyar bind, lu tollu ci fan-weeri ngir bu nekk ci juróomi peyisaas yi.
A gold coin of Rajaraja I (985–1014 CE),: Benn piyeesu wurus bu Rajaraja I (985–1014 ginaaw JC), moo tabaxoon barabu jaamukaay bu mag bi ci Thanjavur. Dafa wane emblem bu buur bu Chola: tigre bu toog, ñaari jën Pandya wër ko, ci suufu parasol bu nguur, ak turu buur bi ci Nagari - Chola dafa wax ni mooy jiite bëj saalum.
A gold half-kahavanu of Virarajendra Cho: Benn genn-wàllu kahavanu wurus bu Virajendra Chola (1063–1070 ginaaw JC). Kahavanu (bu bawoo ci kahapana) xeetu wurus la woon ci Sri Lanka, te wurus Chola biñ def ci xeetu wurus boobu dafay wane jamonoy nguuru Chola ci ile bi.
A guide poem of the Ten Idylls by Kadiya: Taalif buy tegtal fukki idylle yu Kadiyalur Uruthirankannanar bind. Bard bu am yazh bu rëy lañu yóbbu ci Thondaiman Ilanthiraiyan bu Kanchi; ci yoon wi taalif bi dafay wane dëkk yu ndaw yi, poor yi ak nit ñi.
A guide poem of the Ten Idylls by Mudath: Taalif buy tegtal fukki idil yu Mudathama Kanniyar bind. Ab bard buy jouer batëri (porunar) te ñu neexal ko lool, dafay yóbbu beneen bard ci buur bu bari yërmaande bu Chola bii di Karikal Valavan.
A guide poem of the Ten Idylls by Nallur: Taalif buy tegtal fukki idil yu Nallur Nathathanar bind. Benn bard buy jouer yazh bu ndaw (harp) dafay yóbbu beneen ci njiit li di Nalliyakkodan, mu nettali ko jafe-jafey bard yu néew doole yi ak tàngooru patron bu bari yërmaande.
A guide poem of the Ten Idylls by Perunk: Taalif buy tegtal fukki idylle yu Perunkausikanar bind. Ñiy doxantu (koothar) dañu leen di yóbbu ci njiit lii di Nannan; taalif bi ñu ngi ko màggal ndax dafay fësal bruit yu bari yi ci tundu yi.
A large storage jar associated with Adic: Potu dencukaay bu rëy buñ boole ak Adichanallur. Jaar yu yaatu dañuy denc pepp, ndox ak yeneen mbir; ci barabi suul, ay ndab yu tollu nii mën nañu nekk urne. Baatu “dolio” dafay fàttali dolium, di potu dencukaay bu mag bi amoon ci réewum Rome.
A large, round-bellied funerary urn from: Urne dëj bu rëy, am biir bu rond bu bawoo Adichanallur. Urne yu mel ni yii mën nañu gëna njool xale, te defar leen dafay laaj mën-mën bu bari: taalifkat Sangam yi dañuy woo potëri bi defar urne yu mel ni கலம்செய் கோவே - "O buur ci potëri yi".
A lead coin from Andipatti bearing a leg: Benn piyeesu plomb bu bawoo Andipatti am benn léeb ci làkku tamil-brahmi. Lu weesu ñatti buur yiñ takk kuronu, njiiti dëkk yi ci jamonoy Sangam dañu daan génne xaalisu xaalis ci plomb ak përëm, ba noppi taarixu Tamil-Brahmi yi ci kaw dañu jàppale njiit yooyu ñu am tur.
A line drawing of the vimana and a pilla: Nataalu vimana bi ak saal bu am ponki jaamukaay bu Brihadisvara.
A love poem of the Ten Idylls by Kapilar: Taalif mbëggeel ci fukki idylle yu Kapilar bind, ñu def ko ci paysage montagne (kurinji). Aada dafa wax ni dañu ko bind ngir jàngal benn buur bu nord taaru taalif mbëggeel ci Tamil; Dafa tuddee juróom ñeent fukki ak juróom ñeenti flër.
A modern artist’s imagining of a busy ha: Benn artist bu bees dafay xalaat benn poor bu bari ay gaal, marse ak tour, ginaaw biñu ko nettali ci Silappathikaram ak Pattinappalai. Du firnde ci ni dëkk bi meloon dëgg.
A modern sketch imagining ships and buil: Natt bu bees buy wane gaal yi ak tabax yi ci poor bu yàgg bi. Bépp tabaxaat bu Puhar, dafay tekki tegtali bindkat yi; xamu ñu anam wi portu bi di doxee.
A name linked with Nedunalvadai and Tiru: Tur bu lëkkalook Nedunalvadai ak Tirumurukarruppatai ci Fukki Idyll yi - mën na nekk lu ëpp benn taalifkat ci jamono yu wuute. Ginaaw loolu ñu nettali ni dafa bañoon joxe àtteem ci benn taalif ba ci Shiva ci këru Pandya: muy màndargaal fit xam-xam, nekkul lu am solo ci taarix.
A palm-leaf manuscript from the museum’s: Benn mbindu xobi palme bu bawoo ci li musée bi dajale.
A Pandya coin of the “massa” type. Massa: Benn xaalis Pandya bu xeetu "massa". Massa mooy tur wiñ jox xaalisu përëm yu medieval yi, di wane nit ku taxaw ci benn wet gi, ak nit ku toog ci beneen wet gi — xeetu piyeesu Cholas yi tasaare ko, Pandyas yi ak buuru Sri Lanka yi wéyal ko.
A Pandya coin showing a standing king wi: Benn piyeesu xaalis Pandya bu wane buur bu taxaw ak màndarga jën wi. Nataalu njiit lu taxaw, ñu miin ko ci xaalisu përëm bu Chola, Pandyas yi ñoo ko jël bi seen doole delloo ci 13eelu xarnu.
A Pandya coin with the twin fish and a b: Benn xaalisu Pandya bu am seex jën ak benn nag. Jën ñaar ñoo nekkoon màndarga Pandya biy yàgg, ñu tass ko ci banneeru Madurai yi ci taalif yi, ñu daal di koy dóor ci xaalis lu weesu junniy at.
A pipeline of terracotta rings, set one: Benn tuyo bu defaree bague terracotta, ñu def ko ci kaw beneen ci ñeenti dayo, ñu wane ko ci gaskatu Korkai. Tuyo ban buñ lakk ak puusu ring yu mel ni yii dañu daan yóbbu ak dindi ndox ci dëkki réew yu njëkk yu Tamil yi — bokk ci liggéey bi ñuy amal bis bu nekk ci por bu bari ay nit.
A poem of the Ten Idylls by Kadiyalur Ur: Taalif bu Fukki Idil yu Kadiyalur Uruthirankannanar bind, di sargal buuru Chola bi di Karikal Valavan ak dëkkam bu bari ay poor di Kaveripoompattinam (Puhar), ak ay gaalam, ay marse ak ay festiwaal.
A poem of the Ten Idylls by Nakkeerar. D: Taalif bu Fukki Idil yu Nakkeerar bind. Ci jamonoy ngelaw lu gudd te sedd lu bawoo nord ci hiver bi, reine bi dafay namm jëkëram ci jamono ji buur bi di toppatoo ay soldaaram yu gaañu ci camp de xare.
A portrait coin of the Chera king Kuttuv: Nataalu piyeesu xaalis bu buuru Chera Kuttuvan Kotai, ñu tuddee ko ci làkku tamil-brahmi. Ak xaalisu Makkotai, yii xaalis xaalis yu bari - amaana inspiré ci xaalisu portrait yu Rome yiy ñëw ci jënd ak jaay - bokk nañu ci xaalisu Inde yi njëkka wane kanam bu njiit.
A potsherd inscribed in Tamil-Brahmi, fo: Benn xeetu pot buñ bind ci làkku Tamil-Brahmi, ñu fekk ko ci Tissamaharama ci sud Sri Lanka, ñu bind ko ci 2eelu xarnu lu jiitu JC. Bind ci làkku Tamil ci kaw potëri yu sori ci kontinang Tamil dafay wane jaaykat Tamil yi ñuy liggéey ci géej gi ci jamonoy taarix yu njëkk ya.
A rare book from the first decades of Ta: Téere bu bariwul luñu koy gis ci fukki at yu njëkk ci imprime Tamil, bi ñuy njëkka bind mbind yu yàgg yuñ denc ci xobi palme.
A rare volume digitised from CICT’s arch: Benn téere bu bariwul luñu ko digitalisee ci archive CICT ba noppi denc ko ngir jàngat. Kuratëri muse bi dina ñu yokk leeral yi ci katalog bi yépp.
A Sangam-age Chola coin with a tiger and: Fasoŋu Chola bu am jamonoy Sangam ak benn tigre ak benn ñay. Fasoŋu Chola yu njëkk ya, yu gëna bari ci përëm, ñu ngi nekkoon ci diggu tigre bi - benn emblem bi Cholas imperial yi di yóbbaale junniy at ci ginnaaw. Urayur ak Kaveripoompattinam ñoo nekkoon seeni dëkk yu mag.
A Sangam-age Pandya coin, typically a sm: Fasoŋu xaalisu Pandya bu jamonoy Sangam, muy kaare përëm bu ndaw bu am ñay ci benn wet gi ak jën wuñ defar ci beneen wet gi. Fasoŋu xaalis yu mel noonu ñu ngi doon wër ci biir Madurai ak ci ko jege, di kapitaalu Pandya bi ñuy màggal ci Maduraikkanchi.
A scholarly study of government, adminis: Jàngat bu gëstukat yi def ci nguur gi, liggéey bi, ak dundu askan wi ci réewum Tamil ci jamonoy Sangam.
A second coin of the Kongu Cheras. Compa: Ñaareelu xaalis bu Kongu Cheras. Teg leen ñaari mbir yooyu: piyeesu xaalis yiñ defaree loxo dañuy wuute ci strike, wear ak dagg, te wuute yooyu dañuy jàppale numismatist yi ñu tànn seeni mbir ak topp ba ñaata piyees yi des ci circulation.
A second image of the four-armed, seated: Ñaareelu nataalu Ganesha mi am ñeenti loxo, toog. Teg leen xeetu jëmmal, ornament yi ak wëréelu bagaas bi ak bu njëkk bi: ci canon bi ñu bokk ci Silpa Sastras, bépp sculpteur ak atelier dafa bàyyi laal boppam.
A selection drawn from the Thirukkural,: Tanneef buñ jëlee ci Thirukkural, dajale couplet yu kenn du fàtte ngir ñi koy jàng.
A separate photographing of the opening: Nataalu xob yu ubbeeku yi ci 579 D, Maduraikkanchi.
Ab sell bu Shaiva, loxo yu boole ngir jaamu. Buuru Chola yi dañu sargal 63 Nayanmar yi, Sekkizhar nettaliwoon nañu seen dundu ci Periya Puranam, ñu daal di taxawal seeni nataali bronze ci barabi jaamukaay yi, yóbbu leen ci ay màggalug màggal.
A sherd illustrated in Vimala Begley’s 1: Benn xeetu paj buñu wane ci jàngat bu Vimala Begley amal ci 1983 ci dating Arikamedu. Bi Begley xoolaatee wàll yiñ gas, dafa wax ni dëkkuwaay yi tàmbaliwoon nañu ci diggu ñatteelu xarnu lu jiitu JC — balaa Mortimer Wheeler waxoon — ñu daje ak Mediteraane ci diggu ñaareelu xarnu lu jiitu JC. Bis yi mu bind mingi wéy di nekk tegtal bu gëstukat yi.
A sherd of an urn found in 2004, decorat: Benn xeetu urne buñu fekkoon ci atum 2004, ñu defaree ko relief ci jëmmu jigeen bu taxaw ci biir ay motif yu ñuy faral lire ay xeetu mboq, kewel, gru ak benn crocodile. Boroom xam-xam yi gis nañu ci moom ab yaay bu jigéen bu njëkk - ñenn ñi, ni ko filmu bi waxee, ab njiitu Kotravai, yàlla xare bu taalif Sangam. Benn la ci nataali Tamil Nadu yu bariwul luñu koy gis ci jamonoy wen.
A short illustrated guide for visitors:: Gis-gis bu gàtt bu am ay tegtal ngir ñiy ñëw seeti ko: li taalif Sangam yi doon, naka lañu leen boole, ak ni taalif akam ak puram ak juróomi peyisaas yi di doxee.
A silver kasu of Rajendra Chola combinin: Benn kasu xaalis bu Rajendra Chola boole ay màndarga buur - tigre Chola ak jënu Pandya ak arc Chera. Rajendra I (1014–1044 CE) moo yóbbu nguuru Chola ci Ganges, jàll géej gi dem ci Asie Sud-est, te xaalisam yi dañuy fësal ni moo yor ñatti kuronu Tamil yi yépp.
A silver kasu of the “Uttama” type, attr: Benn kasu xaalis bu xeetu "Uttama", ñu jox ko Rajendra I. Xeet wi dafa jël turam ci xaalisu Uttama Chola, bi jëmmal - tigre, jën ak arc ci suufu parasol - dafa def motif xaalis Chola ci ginaaw.
A simplified sequence of how cloth is ma: Ni ñuy defaree mbubb ci anam wu yomb. Dafay leeral anam wi mbir yi di demee; firndewul ni bépp atelier bu yàgg bu Tamil dafa toppoon jéego yii ci njubluwaay bii - jumtukaay yi, ak njubluwaay bi ñuy tëgg ak ràbb, mën nañu wuute.
A small pottery cup from the Adichanallu: Koppu potëri bu ndaw bu bawoo ci dëj Adichanallur. Kopp yi, bool yi ak muur yi bokk nañu ci mbir yiñ daan gëna jëfandikoo ci bàmmeel yi, te seeni jëmm yu rafet, yu maase, dañuy wane mën mënu potëri yi daan liggéey ci pëno bi, defna luy tollu ci ñetti junniy at ci ginaaw.
A summit of Chola architecture, art and: Ndaje bu mag ci architecture, art ak liggéeyu Chola; bokk ci barabi jaamukaay yu mag yiy dundu ci UNESCO.
A temple gopuram over a Madurai street: Jaamukaayu gopuram ci kaw mbedd bu Madurai
A temple gopuram over the street: Jaamukaayu gopuram ci kaw mbedd mi
A vast open-air relief carved across two: Benn relief bu yaatu buñ yatt ci ñaari xeer yu mag, ñu xamee ko ci Penance Arjuna wala Descent of the Ganga, dafay wane boroomam yi, boroom xam-xam yi, baayima yi, ak famiy ñay yu tollu ni dundu, ñuy daje ci benn xar-xar bu natureel.
A village on the Noyyal in Erode distric: Benn dëkk ci Noyyal ci diwaanu Erode, ñu gas ko muy barab bu ñuy defaree perle, liggéey ci gem ak defar wen ak asiye.
A Visitor’s Guide to Sangam Literature: Gidu gëstukat yi ci téere Sangam
A volume connected with the Madurai Tami: Benn téere bu lëkkalook Sangam Tamil bu Madurai, di daara ju mag ju Pandithurai Thevar taxawal ci Madurai ci 1901, ñu koy faral di woowe "ñeenteelu Sangam Tamil".
A volume from the shrine’s collection of: Benn téere bu bawoo ci tekkig Thirukkural yiñ dajale ci barab bu sell bi. Bataaxelu Kural ci njub yegg na ci ñi koy jàng ci làkk yu bari ci Inde ak ci àdduna bi.
A volume on the poetry of Kambar, the gr: Benn téere buy wax ci taalif yu Kambar, di taalifkat bu mag bi ci Kamba Ramayanam (Ramavataram), moom mi xam Tamil moo tax ñu tuddee ko “Kavichakravarthi”, di buur bu mag biy taalifkat yi.
A vyala or yali, the horned, lion-like g: Vyala wala yali, rab wu am bëñ, nuru gaynde, di wottu barabi jaamukaay yi ci Inde du Sud. Pallavas yi dañu ko def seen siif, ñu taxawal ponki yar gaynde ak yalis ci Mamallapuram ak Kanchipuram; ginaaw ga tabaxkat yi yóbbu ko ci saal yu mag yi ci barabu jaamukaay bi.
A wall painting of Gajalakshmi from the: Benn tablo Gajalakshmi bu bawoo ci Big Temple: boroom bi toog ak tànk yu jàkkarloo ci kaw jal bu am lotus, ñaari ñay yu am yéere yu rafet di yëkkati ay pots ak ay lotus ci boppam. Rido yuñ defaree peinture yu diis ci kaw ak xob yu wert yu xawa laxasu ci suuf dañuy wane dekoraasioŋ bu rafet bi am ci mural yu jamonoy Nayak.
A workshop of Pallava art and early Tami: Atelier art Pallava ak tabax barabi jaamukaay yu njëkk yu Tamil; Situ Patrimoine Mondial bu UNESCO.
A yogini, one of a circle of powerful go: Yogini, benn ci yàlla yu jigéen yu am doole yi ñuy jaamu ci aaday tantric. Amna kuréel gu mag gu yoginis yu toog ci xeer yuñ boole ci diwaanu Kanchipuram ci jamonoy Chola; leegi ay misaal am nañu ci muse yi ci àdduna bi yépp.
Aattukkal — Hand Grinding Stone: Aattukkal — Xeer buy yëy ak loxo
About four hundred short akam poems of f: Lu tollu ci ñeenti téemeeri taalif akam yu gàtt yu am ñeent ba juróom ñatti rëdd, bokk ci aaya yiñ gëna joxe ci taalif mbëggeel yu Sangam.
About the 4th – 13th centuries CE: Lu tollu ci 4eem ba 13eem xarnu ginaaw JC.
Across the Kaveri, east of Tiruchirappal: Ci wetu Kaveri, penku Tiruchirappalli, Kallanai taxaw - "barrage doj" - ci liggéey yi gëna yàgg di yamale ndox ci àdduna bi ba leegi ñu ngi koy jëfandikoo. Aada Tamil yi dañu ko jox Karikal Chozhan, di buuru Chola bu njëkk bi ñu màggal ci Pattinappalai, ñu daal di koy def ci diggu ñaareelu xarnu ginaaw JC. The image of Shiva as Nataraja, Lord of: Nataalu Shiva ni Nataraja, Boroom Fecc bi, di fecc ci biir ringu xal, mooy jëmmu bronze bu Chola bi gëna mag. Dafay fësal cycle cosmique bi ci sos, sàmm ak tas.

The kalayam, the everyday Tamil clay pot: Kalayam, di pot ban bu ñuy jëfandikoo bis bu nekk ci Tamil yi. The Kallanai, or Grand Anicut, across th: Kallanai, wala Grand Anicut, jàkkarloo ak Kaveri - ñu koy jox buur Chola Karikala - ñu tabaxoon ko ngir yamale ak soppi ndoxu dex gi ci kanaal ngir irigaasioŋ. The Kanchipuram silk saree is one of the: Saree soi bu Kanchipuram benn la ci yéere cosaan yiñ gëna xam ci Tamil Nadu. Sari bi mingi cosaanoo Kanchipuram, di barab bu bari ay ràbb, muy barab bu siiw ci tissu soie bu riche, liggéeyu zari bu jafee xam, pegg yu wuute, ak motif yu xarañ. Motif yiñ gëna xam ñooy tour temple yi, jàmbu joob yi, mango yi, flër yi ak jëmmal geometrik yi. Saree bi dañu koy ràbb ak fiil soi, ak fiil zari yu am melo wurus wala xaalis ngir yokk ci dekoraasioŋ bi. Kanchipuram soie sarees amna palaas bu am solo ci céet Tamil yi, xew-xewu diine yi, festiwaal yi ak yeneen xew-xew yu mag. Liggéeyu ràbb dafay laaj nga am xam-xam bu bari, rawatina sooy boole yaram wi, fronceer bi, ak pallu bi ci pexe yu yàgg yi ñuy boole. Art bi dafa yàgg a dem, te kenn xamul at bi ñu ko sos ci taarix. Kancheepuram Silk jotna gëdd Geographical Indication (GI) ci 2005. Tay, saree bi dafay màndargaal xéewali mbubb yu Tamil Nadu, art bu xarañ, ak dundu gu wéy gi ci askanu ràbb cosaan.
The Kandangi saree is a traditional cott: Saree Kandangi mbàjji wëtteen la bu cosaanoo ci diwaanu Chettinad, rawatina Karaikudi ak dëkk yi ko jege. Ñu ngi ko xamee ci ay rëdd yu dëgër, ay rayoŋ, ay rëdd yu wuute, ak ay melo yu dëgër, lu ci melni xonk, mutard, orange, ak maroŋ bu am suuf. Bu njëkkoon, tissu wëtteen bu dëgër bi mënoon nañu ko jëfandikoo saa yu nekk, muy wane ni yéere yi ñuy sol bis bu nekk lañuy laaj. Tissu Kandangi dafay wane xam-xam bu wuute ci wàllu taar ak mbàjj ci diwaanu Chettinad. Motif yi ak melo yi mu àndal ñoo ko wuutale ci yeneen aada sari yu Inde du Sud. Ni ñuy defaree mbubb mi mooy waajal fiil bi, raññe buum yi ci kaw loom bi, ràbb tissu bi, ba noppi defar bordure yi ak jeexal ko. Mbir yi nguur gi di defaree loxo dañu wax ni cosaan ak aada yaa ngi am lu ëpp 150 at, waaye kenn xamul kañ lañu ko tàmbalee. Kandangi sarees jot nañu gëdd GI ci 2019, dimbali nañu leen ñu xàmmee ak baña yàq seen dàntite diwaan ak seen art cosaan.

The Koorainadu saree is associated with: Sari Koorainadu mingi méngoo ak Koorainadu ci wetu Mayiladuthurai ci Tamil Nadu. Dafa gëna jëm ci yéere céet yu cosaanoo ak solo si mbàjj yi am ci xew-xewu céet yu waa Tamil. Xeetu tissu cosaan yi ñooy tissu soi ak soi-wëtteen, ñu am jëmmal ak meceer yu wuute, lépp di aju ci stil bi ak njariñ li ci nekk. Saree dafay wane njariñu yéere yuñ ràbb ci xew-xew yu am solo yi ci famiy yi ak joxe cosaan ak aada mbàjj ci diggante ay jamono. Melokaanam, tissu, ak màndarga dekoraasioŋ mën nañu wuute, kon misaal yi benn-benn dañu wara bind ci seen taax dëgg, du ñu xalaat ni Koorainadu saree bu nekk dafa topp benn jëmmal. Kenn xamul bu baax at bi cosaan ak aada boobu tàmbalee. Koorainadu sarees mingi wéy di nekk mbir mu am solo ngir jàngat diggante yéere, dàntite gox, art, ak dundu xew-xew ci Tamil Nadu.
The Kovai Kora cotton saree is associate: Saree wëtteen bu Kovai Kora mingi méngoo ak Coimbatore ak gox yi ko jege di defar yéere. Ñu ngi ko defaree wëtteen, ñu bëgg ko ndax taaram gu woyof gi, texturam bu neex, ak pegg yu cosaan ak aada. Buñu ko méngale ak sarees soie yu taaru lool, mbusu wëtteen Kora dafay faral di fësal melokaanu wëtteen, neexa sol, ak ay detay yu ndaw ci jëmmal. Sari bi dafay wane solo si am ci bay wëtteen, defar fiil, ràbb ak jaay yéere ci Tamil Nadu. Defar sari buñ defaree loxo fàww nga waajal bu baax buum yi ak buum yi, ba noppi nga xam bu baax ni ñuy jëfandikoo loom bi. Wëtteen Kora baaxna ci xew-xew yu bari, lu ci melni sol bis bu nekk ak ndaje yu mag. Kovai Kora Cotton jot gëdd GI ci 2008. At biñu ko sos gëna jub, waaye cosaan bi des na misaal bu am solo ci xeetu wëtteen yu bari yi réew mi am.

The Madurai Sungudi saree is a tradition: Saree Sungudi bu Madurai mbubb la buñ defaree wëtteen buñ boole ak Madurai, di barabu cosaan ak aada bu am taarix ci Tamil Nadu. Li koy wuutale mooy motif yu tombu yi, jëmmal yu bari melo yi, ak pexem cravate ak tinte wala resist-tye. Bu ñuy tinte dañuy takk wàll yu ndaw ci tissu bi wala ñu aar ko ngir sos motif yu fës suñuy ubbi macceer bi. Textile Sungudi dañu ko jox solo ndax seen melokaan bu rafet, tissu wëtteen bu woyof, te mën nañu ko jëfandikoo bis bu nekk ak yéere yu màggal. Art bi dafa boole xam-xam bi ci waajal tissu, pexem ràbb, tëgg ak jeexal. Taarixam nekkul luñu ko tënk ci benn at buñu bind bu baax. Madurai Sungudi jotna gëdd GI ci 2005, muy gëdd limu àndal ak gox bi. Aada bi dafay wane ni artiste Tamil yi defaree jëmmal mbubb mu wuute ak yeneen yi, jëfandikoo xam-xam bu yam ci tinte ak xeeti defar yuñ miin ci gox bi.
The masonry arches that now crown the an: Arc maçonnerie yi leegi dañuy kuronu weir bu yàgg bi.
